title: demo.begin (server → platform, ephemeral)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (FLEET.md §12.2). Announces a GOTV demo that the server streams while it records, and asks where to resume. Envelope epoch = the epoch of the assignment the demo belongs to (it may have ended since: the platform accepts demos of assignments the server holds or held). Sent when recording starts, again on every new session (reconnect), after a plugin reload or server restart, when a demo.ack says unknown_demo, and when no demo.ack arrived for 15 s while bytes were in flight (backoff 5 s, 10 s, 20 s ... 5 min while unanswered). Idempotent on demo_id. The platform MUST answer with demo.ack {demo_id, offset = bytes it has stored contiguously from 0 (0 for a new demo)}, or complete: true when it already verified the whole file; the server sends demo.chunk only after that answer and continues from its offset.

demo_id.description: Generated by the server when the recording starts; names this demo in every demo.* message.

file.description: Basename of the .dem on the server; store it under demos/<match_id>/map<N>/<file>.

chunk_size.description: Every demo.chunk of this demo starts at a multiple of chunk_size and is chunk_size bytes long, except the last chunk of the file.

recording.description: true while the file may still grow; false once the recording stopped (demo.end follows).

restart.description: true: drop every byte stored for this demo_id and answer offset 0 (the local file was replaced, or the platform's copy failed the sha256 check). Absent = false.
